mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'CALCULATED' THEN CAST(e.cost_fen AS DECIMAL(65,18)) ELSE 0 END),0) AS used_cost_fen, COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'CALCULATED' THEN 1 END) AS calculated_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'UNPRICED' THEN 1 END) AS unpriced_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'UNCALCULABLE' THEN 1 END) AS uncalculable_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'NOT_CHARGEABLE' THEN 1 END) AS not_chargeable_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.cost_status IS NULL OR CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY) NOT IN (_binary'CALCULATED',_binary'UNPRICED',_binary'UNCALCULABLE',_binary'NOT_CHARGEABLE') OR (CAST(e.cost_status AS BINARY)=_binary'CALCULATED' AND e.cost_fen IS NULL) THEN 1 END) AS invalid_count FROM () e WHERE e.budget_applied=1
